title: viola odorata subsp. subcarnea
intro: Viola odorata subsp. subcarnea, commonly known as Woodland Pansy or Alpine Pansy, is a subspecies of the sweet violet plant. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and stress, as well as its antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Viola odorata subsp. subcarnea include its sedative and antidepressant effects, which can help alleviate anxiety and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, anthocyanins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
